rejected_artifacts.reason: sdist substitution is forbidden; HWM accepts only the reviewed wheel

dependency_lock.policy: Select only the default dependency closure for CPython 3.12.10/linux-x86_64. Every selected direct/transitive distribution must be exact-versioned and verified against a sha256 recorded in the immutable lock. Optional extras and dev groups are forbidden. Build/extraction jobs must not perform floating resolution.

install.phase_a_network: allow only pypi.org and files.pythonhosted.org for artifacts whose exact filename/version/hash is selected from this manifest plus the immutable default closure in upstream uv.lock
install.phase_b_network: deny all egress before product checkout is parsed
procedure: Create a fresh virtual environment with CPython 3.12.10.
Materialize the CPython-3.12.10/linux-x86_64 default closure from the immutable upstream uv.lock; fail if any artifact lacks an expected sha256.
Acquire only those exact hashed distributions and the accepted graphifyy wheel; reject sdists and unexpected filenames.
Install offline from the verified local wheelhouse with dependency resolution disabled.
Delete/disable network access, validate provider/remote-database environment deny policy, then run extraction.
